retrievalProfile.description: A central figure leaning against massive, symmetrical stacks of industrial audio speakers in a clean studio environment.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a man in urban streetwear, positioned centrally and leaning back against a vertical stack of large black speakers. The scene is framed by two identical columns of quad-driver speakers, creating a symmetrical 'V' or 'U' shaped negative space in the center where the subject resides.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between left and right speaker stacks
Contrast between the dark, industrial texture of the speakers and the light-colored clothing
Diagonal lean of the subject against the vertical grid of the equipment
Hard studio lighting creating sharp shadows and highlighting metallic textures
coreInvariants: Neutral studio background with floor-to-wall transition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame, full-body scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical columns of speakers act as heavy visual anchors on the left and right margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical lines of the speakers down to the subject's feet, then moves up the diagonal line of his leaning body to his face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A narrow vertical corridor of light-colored background between the dark speaker stacks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light grey (clothing and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the equipment.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a man in baggy white streetwear and a cap leaning against a tall stack of black professional audio speakers. Ensure a second identical stack is on the opposite side to frame him. Use hard lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use bold, sans-serif display type positioned in the upper third negative space or vertically aligned with the speaker edges.

verificationChecks: Is the subject leaning at a diagonal angle?
Is the lighting harsh enough to show texture on the speaker grilles?
Is the background a clean studio gradient?

adjustableVariables: Number of speaker drivers in the stacks
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Verify the speaker grilles have a consistent circular pattern.
Ensure the subject's feet are grounded on the studio floor.
Check that the headphones and cap are rendered with clear fabric/plastic textures.
Confirm the central negative space is clear of distractions.
recipe.reuseFormula: Position a [Subject Type] in [Clothing Style] leaning against [Industrial Object] framed by [Symmetrical Duplicates of Object] in a [Lighting Style] studio setting.
